NASA IS PREPARING TO SEND HUMANS AROUND THE MOON FOR THE FIRST TIME IN 50 YEARS.

In 2025 and 2026, NASA finalized crew training and spacecraft assembly for Artemis II, the first crewed lunar mission since Apollo 17 in 1972. The four-person crew—including the first female and first person of color on a lunar mission—will test the Orion spacecraft during a flyby of the Moon. The mission is the critical gateway to placing a permanent lunar base camp on the Moon's South Pole, re-establishing deep space exploration capabilities after five decades of low-Earth orbit operations.
